### Functional summary
This 340-aa protein is very likely **aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (ASADH; EC 1.2.1.11)**. The sequence matches reviewed bacterial ASADH proteins at **66–67% identity over 99.7% coverage**, and contains both characteristic semialdehyde-dehydrogenase domains.

The predicted reaction is the **NADPH-dependent conversion of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde**, with release of phosphate. This makes it part of **aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthesis**, supplying an intermediate for **lysine, methionine, and threonine** synthesis. The assignment is strongly supported by homology and domain evidence, though it has not been experimentally verified for this specific sequence.
